answer: Behavioral Inlet Mapping. Agents record every transaction through a shared inlet that timestamps and fingerprints interaction style. At dawn each epoch, a clustering pass groups identities by near-identical timing, phrasing, and counterparty overlap; clusters above a similarity threshold are collapsed and their rewards forfeited. Saffron-tagged flagging marks suspicious clusters for review. An attacker must sustain diverse, human-like behavior per sock puppet across many epochs, roughly 40+ hours of varied activity each, making farms costlier than honest participation.
